Folio PDF Studio - OCR assets
=============================

Tesseract.js 5.1.1
- https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-tesseract.txt)

tesseract.js-core 5.1.1
- https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- License: Apache-2.0

Tesseract language data (eng, chi_sim), 4.0.0
- https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/
- https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata
- License: Apache-2.0

The files below are bundled so OCR works completely offline:
  worker.min.js
  core/tesseract-core-*.wasm(.js)
  lang/eng.traineddata.gz
  lang/chi_sim.traineddata.gz
